text:
Lena: Quick sync  launching a small OSS kit 'bytebench' (reference app + tutorial + perf badge). Goals: get contributors, webinar signups, and measurable leads. TL;DR: blog + live workshop + partner shares. Thoughts?

Arjun: Love it. Keep the tutorial runnable in one command. Add CPU fallback and a tiny dataset. I'll add `examples/quick` and `scripts/run_local.sh`.

Ben: Webinar format idea: 10m intro, 20m live build-along, 10m perf demo (batching/cache), 10m Q&A. Make the live part truly hands-on: attendees should hit a success checkpoint in 8 minutes.

Mika: For messaging, lead line draft: "Bytebench: a tiny reference app + perf badge to run reproducible inference tests in minutes." Short, technical, and scan-friendly.

Tara: Inbound routing: we'll use HubSpot form `hs_bytebench_launch`. Hidden utm `utm_campaign=bytebench_q2`. Add checkbox `enterprise_interest`. Route mapping: enterprise=true -> AE queue; else -> devrel nurture.

Arjun: I'll ensure repo has `quickstart.sh` and `bench/bench.py` with flags: `--batch`, `--quant`, `--csv-out`. Will open PR tonight.

Ben: Social copy (short):
- "Bytebench: run a perf badge locally and compare settings. Join our live workshop. RSVP -> <https://events.redwood.com/bytebench>"
- "Benchmark snapshot: batching x3 throughput. Reproduce in 2 commands. -> <https://github.com/redwood-inference/bytebench>"

Mika: Benchmark narrative owner? Need a short methodology: p50/p95, 100-token payload, instance type used (local quant), batch settings. Also explain fallbacks & routing so folks see reliability benefits. I'll draft the blurb.

Tara: HubSpot mapping snippet for eng (for webhook):

`{ "form_id": "hs_bytebench_launch", "fields": { "email": "email", "name": "firstname", "company": "company", "enterprise_interest": "enterprise_interest" }, "routing": { "enterprise_interest": "AE_QUEUE", "else": "DEVREL_NURTURE" } }`

Arjun: Sample README snippet for the workshop to show latency test:

```
# start a local run
bash quickstart.sh --local
# run a quick latency test
python bench/bench.py --model local-quant --tokens 100 --batch 4 --runs 5 --csv out.csv
```

Ben: Can design produce a small PNG of bench results for social (simple bar chart)? design-bot, can you pick this up?

design-bot: Assigned. Will create a 600x320 PNG and a 6s GIF of the bench p95 change. Delivery: 48h.

Arjun: PR opening now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bytebench/pull/12  includes `examples/quick`, `quickstart.sh`, and `bench/bench.py`. Tagging @Mika.

Mika: Thanks. I'll write the benchmark methodology and include a reproducible `bench/run_repro.sh` so marketing can generate the PNG.

Lena: Owners (quick):
- Repo quickstart & bench -> Arjun
- Blog + benchmark narrative -> Mika
- Webinar + runbook -> Ben
- HubSpot form + routing -> Tara
- Social assets + GIF -> design-bot

hs-bot: Reminder: rehearsal slots available Tue 3pm & Thu 11am. Use `/reserve @Ben @Arjun` to book.

Arjun: PR live. I'll post a short bench sample once I run the script.

Tara: Routing rule tweak: only notify #sales-inbound when `enterprise_interest=true && company_size > 50`. I'll add this filter to the webhook.

Ben: Comms plan: publish blog + GH release Mon, webinar Wed, follow-up email with recording + contributor guide Fri. Mika, can you include a 'how to contribute' quick section linking to `good-first-issues`?

Mika: Yup — will add `CONTRIBUTING.md` and label a set of starter issues. Also will include a short PR checklist.

Arjun: Bench sample numbers (local run): p50=68ms, p95=185ms with batch=4 on local-quant. CSV and PNG output in `marketing/assets/bytebench/bench-snapshot.png`.

Ben: Great. I'll draft social hooks and media one-pager for outreach. Also plan to ask two partners to cross-post.

Lena: Growth asks: can we set up a 3-email drip for registrants? Tara: yes, create drip: 1) thanks + recording; 2) how-to contribute + issues; 3) enterprise trial invite. Also create an Ads audience for registrants who visited pricing.

Tara: Workflow `hs_workflow_bytebench_03` created and live. Tracking utm and audience set.

design-bot: PNG uploaded to `marketing/assets/bytebench/bench-snapshot.png`. GIF in same folder.

Arjun: PR merged. Bench assets in repo. Tagging marketing for blog images.

Mika: Draft blog link: https://docs.google.com/draft/bytebench-launch  adding bench table and contributions section now.

Ben: Event created: "Bytebench Workshop"  Wed Jun 9 10:00 PDT. Registration: <https://events.redwood.com/bytebench>.

Lena: Perfect. We'll reconvene after rehearsal for final signoff. Thanks everyone :rocket:
